Import results produced elsewhere

Source: R/run.R
as_msa_runs.Rd

Turns a data.frame of results from any pipeline into an msa_runs object, so that the analysis functions can be used without running the backend through this package. The minimum is one row per call with the item, prompt variant, model, replicate number and parsed value.

Usage

as_msa_runs(
  x,
  item = "item_id",
  prompt = "prompt_id",
  model = "model_id",
  rep = "rep",
  value = "value",
  block = "block",
  design = NULL
)

Arguments

x

A data.frame.

item, prompt, model, rep, value, block

Column names in x.

design

Optional msa_design the results belong to.

Value

An msa_runs data.frame.

Examples

df <- expand.grid(item_id = paste0("I", 1:5), prompt_id = c("P1", "P2"),
                  model_id = c("m1", "m2"), rep = 1:2, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
df$value <- rnorm(nrow(df))
r <- as_msa_runs(df)
class(r)
#> [1] "msa_runs"   "data.frame"
